The historical vignette filename is retained. Fitting uses Flax, Optax and the installed Python package. No Torch installation is used.

Install the matching Python package as described in the README and set
RETICULATE_PYTHON before starting R. These synthetic examples use a projected
CPU grid. Short runs demonstrate the API; assess convergence and sampler
diagnostics before scientific use.

```{r example}
library(DiffiScape)
library(terra)
basis <- rast(nrows = 4L, ncols = 5L, xmin = 0, xmax = 5,
              ymin = 0, ymax = 4, crs = "EPSG:3857",
              vals = seq(0, 1, length.out = 20))
pts <- as.data.frame(xyFromCell(basis, c(1, 3, 3, 5, 8, 12, 15, 18, 20)))
output_dir <- tempdir()
results <- run_jax_pipeline(basis, pts, model_type = "mlp",
  model_config = list(hidden_dim = 4L, n_hidden_layers = 1L),
  n_epochs = 5L, source_spacing = 2L, output_dir = output_dir)
plot(results$loss_history, type = "l")
prediction <- ds_predict(results, basis_stack = basis)
```
